contract: GMLI China M2 official-source candidate v2
purpose: Replace the opaque legacy China stitch prospectively with a reproducible PBoC-native M2 level history while preserving the existing GMLI seven-region architecture and evaluating the impact before any Core promotion.

methodology_policy.candidate_rule: Treat this as a new versioned production-source candidate. Compare it with the legacy benchmark; do not call it the missing historical exact rerun.
preferred_source_order: PBoC Statistics -> year -> Money and Banking Statistics -> Money Supply -> HTML
PBoC monthly Financial Statistics Report as an independent latest-value cross-check

history_contract.discovery: Discover each year's Money and Banking Statistics page from the official PBoC Statistics index, then resolve its Money Supply HTML table. Do not depend on search-engine ranking or opaque legacy mirrors.
history_contract.current_year_requirement: all populated M2 months through the latest official table update
history_contract.raw_byte_policy: Preserve the Statistics index, each yearly Money Supply HTML payload, source URL, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256.
history_contract.precision: Use the official table values in RMB 100 million directly; do not round to trillion-yuan report values for the history series.

known_breaks.description: PBoC improved the money-market-fund component of money supply statistics and retrospectively revised 2017 M2 growth for comparability. The official level tables remain the V2 accounting history; the break is explicitly recorded.
e-CNY was added to M0; PBoC states revised M1/M2 growth rates were not materially changed.
PBoC revised M1 definition; this contract uses M2 and records the break for provenance only.

current_cross_check.note: Rounded report values are a cross-check only. The HTML Money Supply table is the authoritative precision source for V2 levels.

historical_cross_check.note: Independent rounded cross-check for the newly added 2014 official HTML history; exact history value continues to come from the Money Supply table.

promotion_policy: A complete official V2 series may be used to construct a new Money candidate and rerun the locked transmission evaluation. Promotion, if justified, is a new version decision and does not alter the historical fact that the old v1.8b exact rerun was impossible.
